mapper.insert: insert into sys_ocr_task (task_id, user_id, file_name, file_url, status, error_message, create_time, update_time, start_time, complete_time, queue_position, consumer_id, execute_duration_ms) values (#{taskId}, #{userId}, #{fileName}, #{fileUrl}, #{status}, #{errorMessage}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{startTime}, #{completeTime}, #{queuePosition}, #{consumerId}, #{executeDurationMs})
mapper.select: select id, task_id, user_id, file_name, file_url, status, error_message, create_time, update_time, start_time, complete_time, queue_position, consumer_id, execute_duration_ms from sys_ocr_task where user_id = #{userId} order by id desc
